description: This file defines the WorkSpacesClient class, which is a PHP client wrapper for the AWS WorkSpaces service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to Amazon WorkSpaces, indicating the methods available for interacting with the service asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: WorkSpacesClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for interacting with Amazon WorkSpaces service, extending the generic AwsClient class and providing method annotations for all supported operations.
